operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Operate and maintain according to manufacturer's written instructions or permittee-developed procedures approved by engine manufacturer. Only change settings permitted by manufacturer that do not increase air emissions.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 10 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No operation for scheduled maintenance, readiness testing, stack testing or operator training (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30. Exceptions require DEQ NRO approval.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 10 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: During integration operational period, operation (involving fuel combustion) between 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. any day during May 1 through September 30 shall only occur if forecast Air Quality Index (AQI) for ozone for Northern Virginia is "less than or equal to" 100. If Air Alert issued, minimize operation to maximum extent practical.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Only operate in situations arising from sudden/unforeseeable events (electrical grid failure, on-site disaster, public service emergencies), ISO-declared emergencies, scheduled maintenance and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT), non-scheduled maintenance/testing/operational training, and integration operational period. Total emissions for any 12-month period shall not exceed limits stated in Conditions 15, 17, 18, 19.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 10 through 12)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Shall not operate more than 2,000 ekW electrical power. Compliance demonstrated by electric output data from monitoring device in Condition 3.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 1 through 9)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 200 hours per year, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each emergency diesel engine gen-set equipped with SCR (Ref. Nos. 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 & 9)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 50 hours per year without urea injection, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 10 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 36 hours per year for scheduled maintenance and readiness testing (Scheduled MCRT).

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 10 through 12)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 400 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 9) combined.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Each individual emergency diesel engine gen-set (Ref. Nos. 13 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: No more than 300 hours per year for all purposes (as provided in Condition 9) combined.

operationalLimits.appliesTo: Emergency diesel engine gen-sets (Ref. Nos. 1 through 17)
operationalLimits.limitDetails: Approved fuel is diesel fuel oil (ULSD, HVO, or blend). Must meet ASTM D975 for grade ultra-low sulfur 2-D or 2-D S15, OR maximum sulfur content 0.0015% (15 ppm), and either minimum cetane number 40 or maximum aromatic content 35% by volume.

emissionLimits.conditions: Except during one 6-minute period in any one hour not exceeding 10% opacity, as determined by EPA Method 9.
